source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Electrical-Body and Chassis, p.12-31

procedures.title: Left-hand instrument cluster (speedometer/tachometer): remove and install
steps: Remove the screws and washers holding the left instrument panel at the door opening, the dash top and the left side of the center panel.
Unclip and remove the forward trim panel of the floor console.
Ease the cluster forward far enough to undo the speedometer and tachometer cable housing nuts, unplug the headlamp and ignition switch connectors, and pull the panel lamps.
Install in reverse order without kinking the speedometer or tachometer cable housings.
notes: See figure 47 in the manual. The left pod holds the 160 mph speedometer and 7000 rpm tachometer.

procedures.title: Center instrument cluster (console gauge pack): remove and install
steps: Remove the screws from the right side dash pad (see Section 1B).
Take out the clipped-in forward trim pads of the center floor console.
Pull the radio knobs and remove the bezel nuts from the front.
Reaching behind the radio, disconnect the antenna lead, speaker and electrical leads.
Remove the radio rear support and slide the receiver out to the right.
Remove the upper center console trim plate screws, tip the plate forward, unplug the wiper switch, and set the plate aside until reassembly.
Remove the screws at the left side of the center console.
Remove the nuts on the underside of the console studs (see figure 48 in the manual).
Tilt the console forward and disconnect the oil line, electrical connectors and lamps at its back.
Lift the console up and forward to remove it, and set it carefully on the bench.
